The adult population has not been sampled for fecal parasites in the past year. The program of veterinary care requires
the licensee to do fecal tests on 10% of the population annually. Not sampling the population for fecal parasites as
required by the program of veterinary care doesn't ensure the population is free from the various fecal parasites that can
infect them. The licensee must sample the population for fecal parasites in accordance with the written directive that is in
the program of veterinary care. Correct by 7/23/26.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the licensee.
End of report.

narrative:
3.13(a)(3) 
   
Veterinary care for dogs. 
The adult population has not been sampled for fecal parasites in the past year. The program of veterinary care requires 
the licensee to do fecal tests on 10% of the population annually. Not sampling the population for fecal parasites as 
required by the program of veterinary care doesn't ensure the population is free from the various fecal parasites that can 
infect them. The licensee must sample the population for fecal parasites in accordance with the written directive that is in 
the program of veterinary care. Correct by 7/23/26. 
 
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the licensee. 
 
End of report.
